title: A quiver approach to quasi-quantum groups with the Chevalley property
summary: In this paper, we develop a quiver approach to coquasi-Hopf algebras with the dual Chevalley property. We introduce a modified generalized path coalgebra $\Bbbk(\mathrm{Q},\mathcal{S})$ associated with a given quiver $\mathrm{Q}$ and a collection of simple coalgebras $\mathcal{S}=\{C_i\mid i\in \mathrm{Q}_0\}$ indexed by the vertices of $\mathrm{Q}$, such that its link quiver coincides with $\mathrm{Q}$.
